name: Alidrop
summary: Dropshipping automation — product sourcing, fulfilment and inventory sync, with access to faster-shipping US and EU suppliers. The subscription sits on top of wholesale cost, so margins still turn on product selection and ad efficiency.
best_for: dropshippers who want automated product sourcing, fulfillment and inventory sync with access to faster-shipping suppliers and one-click store integration
skip_if: you want the absolute widest catalog at rock-bottom sourcing cost, or your margins can't absorb both the subscription and wholesale product cost
honest_knock: Alidrop's pitch includes faster-shipping (including US/EU) suppliers, but the core dropshipping economics still apply: you pay the subscription plus wholesale product cost, and margins live or die on product selection and ad efficiency, not the tool. The low Starter product cap nudges serious stores up to Pro quickly, and as with any dropshipping automation, the platform reduces but doesn't remove supplier-quality and shipping-time risk. Sample before you scale.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-02 on their own pricing page) Four monthly plans: Starter $39/mo (50 unique / 25 premium products), Professional $59/mo (500 unique / 250 premium), Empire $99/mo (5,000 unique / 2,500 premium) and Unicorn $299/mo (25,000 unique / 25,000 premium). A 7-day trial costs $1, and there are no transaction or hidden fees. Annual billing is listed only from Professional up — $288, $684 and $948 a year — and the discount grows with the tier: 6 months off Professional, 5 off Empire and 8 off Unicorn, so the advertised “up to 8 months off” is the Unicorn rate rather than a general one, and Starter has no annual column at all. An optional one-time custom-store build service starts at $299. The $1 trial converts to the full monthly rate of whichever plan you picked, and your card stays on file — set a reminder if you are only testing.
